title: Principal Backend Engineer
description:
Anvil Commerce runs one of the larger online marketplaces in Switzerland.

We look for a Principal Engineer with at least 12 years of backend experience and 4 years as a technical lead of a team of 10 or more engineers. You decide the architecture of our order platform (Java, Kafka, PostgreSQL) and you report to the CTO.

Visa support is available for the right person.
